about.title: A digital sanctuary for readers.
about.intro: Readen is a personal library, not another feed. Here is why it exists, what we believe, and where it is going.
about.story: Reading apps became feeds: noisy, social, optimized for engagement instead of the book. I built Readen because I missed the feeling of a personal library. A shelf that is yours. Books that stay where you put them. A calm place to read, track, and rediscover what matters to you.
about.value1: No feeds, no pressure. Your library is a quiet room.
about.value2: Covers that feel physical. Shelves that feel real. Details matter.
about.value3: No ads, no data selling. Your reading life belongs to you.

careers.title: Help build the app people close.
careers.intro: Readen is a small team with a simple conviction: your reading life deserves a calm home, not a feed. We build slowly, sweat details most apps skip, and measure success in books finished, not minutes spent.
careers.pillar1Body: Covers that behave like books and shelves that feel like glass exist because someone cared past the point of reason. That is the job.
careers.pillar2Body: We don't chase streaks, feeds, or engagement. We build features that end sessions well: for readers, and for ourselves.
careers.pillar3Body: Everyone here shapes the product. Your judgment ends up on the shelf, not in a backlog.
careers.ctaBody: Two roles, both foundational to what Readen becomes next. Write to us with what you'd build.
careers.role1Body: Full-stack, mobile-first. You'd own features end to end, from the Supabase schema to the shelf that renders it.
careers.role2Body: You'd shape every screen a reader sees, and decide what calm actually looks like in this app.

faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.intro: Everything about the app, your data, and how Readen works. If your question is not here, we are one email away.
faq.ctaBody: Write to us and a human will answer, usually within a day.

what.a: Readen is a personal book library for iOS and Android. Curate your shelf by status: want to read, reading, read. Scan barcodes, track sessions, set goals, and discover a curated catalog of books recommended by remarkable readers.

platforms.q: Which platforms is Readen available on?
platforms.a: Readen is available on iOS and Android. A web version of the app is planned for a future release.

free.a: Yes. Readen is free to use with no ads and no data selling.

scan.a: Open the Scan tab and point your camera at any book's ISBN barcode. Readen looks up the book metadata and adds it to your shelf instantly.

data.q: Where does book data come from?
data.a: Book metadata comes from established catalog providers. Our curated discover catalog is built from recommendations by world-class readers.

account.a: You can build a starter shelf before signing in. An account (via Google or Apple) is only needed to save and sync your library across devices.

offline.a: Your library is available offline. Reading sessions queue locally and sync when you are back online.

delete.q: How do I delete my account?
delete.a: Go to Settings → Account in the app and tap Delete Account. Your data will be permanently removed.

recommendations.a: Readen's discover catalog is curated by People: founders, investors, scientists, artists. Not an algorithmic feed. Each recommendation comes from a real reader.

contact.a: Email us at hello@readen.co and we will get back to you.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service govern your use of Readen, a personal book library and reading tracker operated by Readen ("we", "us"). By creating an account or using the app, you agree to these terms.
terms.useBody: Readen is built for your personal reading life: cataloging the books you own, tracking reading sessions, and discovering new titles. It is provided for personal, non-commercial use.
terms.accountBody: You can build a starter shelf without an account. To save and sync your library across devices, you sign in with Google or Apple. You are responsible for keeping access to your account secure.
terms.contentBody: Your library is yours: the books you add, your shelves, reading sessions, and goals. By using Readen you grant us the limited right to store and sync this data solely to provide the service. We claim no ownership over it.
terms.bookDataBody: Covers, titles, and metadata come from established book catalog providers. We work to keep the catalog accurate, but we cannot guarantee that every edition, cover, or page count is correct.
terms.acceptableBody: Do not scrape, reverse engineer, resell, or disrupt the service, and do not use Readen to store content that is unlawful or infringes the rights of others.
terms.terminationBody: You may delete your account at any time in Settings → Account; your data is permanently removed. We may suspend accounts that violate these terms, with notice where reasonable.
terms.liabilityBody: Readen is provided "as is", without warranties of any kind. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from your use of the service.
terms.changesBody: We may update these terms as the product evolves. If a change is significant, we will let you know in the app before it takes effect. Continuing to use Readen after that means you accept the updated terms.
terms.contactBody: Questions about these terms? Write to hello@readen.co.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Readen is the reading app you close, and that philosophy extends to your data: we collect the minimum needed to keep your library in sync, and we never sell it. This policy explains what we collect, why, and your rights.
privacy.collectBody: Account basics from Google or Apple sign-in (name, email, avatar), your library data (books, shelves, reading sessions, goals), and anonymized usage analytics that help us understand which features matter.
privacy.notCollectBody: No ads, no ad tracking, no selling or renting your data, no cross-site profiles. Barcode scanning happens on your device: the camera reads the ISBN and the image is discarded, never uploaded.
privacy.useBody: To provide Readen: syncing your library across devices, saving your page, tracking sessions and goals, and showing book metadata. Aggregated, anonymized statistics guide product decisions.
privacy.storageBody: Your library is stored on trusted cloud infrastructure, encrypted in transit. Reading sessions recorded offline stay on your device and sync when you are back online.
privacy.thirdPartyBody: We rely on a small set of providers for authentication, database hosting, book metadata, and privacy-first analytics (no cookies, no cross-site tracking). Each processes data only as needed to provide the service.
privacy.rightsBody: You can access and edit your library in the app at any time, and delete your account in Settings → Account: all associated data is permanently removed. For anything else (export, correction, questions), email us.
privacy.changesBody: If we change how we handle your data, we will update this page and note it in the app. We will never quietly weaken your privacy.
